text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services recommends stop control for the minor street at the uncontrolled "T" type intersection of Earl Grey Road at Ravina Crescent in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Earl Grey Road at Ravina Crescent.
